name: Animal Lover
source:
Evil forces have turned these five hunky beefcake time-displaced boys into animals! You've got to help cure them and maybe even fall in love! Mystery! Intrigue! Romance! No furries, despite the title!

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/542200]Steam[/url]]
translation:
邪恶力量把这五位来自不同时代的健壮帅哥变成了动物！你得帮助他们解除诅咒，说不定还会坠入爱河！谜团！阴谋！浪漫！虽然标题里有“动物”，但本作并没有兽人角色！

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/542200]Steam[/url]]
